newsitem.title: UK: Body found in Belfast near explosion site.
newsitem.headline: Body found in Belfast near explosion site.

text.p: Northern Ireland police said the body of a man was discovered on a Belfast housing estate and there were reports of a small explosion in the same area.
They said they were investigating both the explosion and the manner of the man's death.
Security sources said it did not appear the man had died in any sectarian attack.
Northern Ireland has been gripped by a wave of Catholic violence since police allowed a Protestant parade down a Catholic zone of Portadown on Sunday.
Home-made bombs have been hurled at police in a wave of protest that has so far injured 80 people but killed no one.
